scope: Top 50 municipalities by 2025 official population estimates plus all state/territorial capitals. Official municipal flags only; Brasília uses the Federal District flag.
policy: Official municipal flags only. Historical and proposed replacements are excluded. Source artwork is retained without redrawing; only local display thumbnails are resized.
